jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager, Growth Marketing

jobs.title: Operations Excellence and Innovation Manager, YouTube

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Planning & Product Operations

jobs.gap: Senior-manager scope at a large enterprise may require more years of direct product-operations leadership and deeper strategic planning experience. This should be treated as a stretch application.

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager

jobs.gap: The role may favor candidates with deeper direct client-operations management and commercial ownership. Kevin should highlight stakeholder communication, operational follow-through, and measurable service improvements.
